title: A DEAD PILLBOX LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Pillbox left the generic purple cache box. The cache is now tagged a Pillbox wreck and drawn as the emplacement in pieces in its own palette: the cracked plinth, the burst squashed drum, the dead port, bent and fallen brass pipes, smoke while unsearched. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Pillbox leaves a smoking wreck, not a box.
